about_the_game:
Memories with You - is the final game in the "to You" series of visual novels. Find out what ultimately happens to the main characters of the series, Harlequin and Alicia, and dive into another crazy romantic story!

The protagonist, whose life has suddenly been pushed to the edge due to a terrifying diagnosis, spends his final days in a bar trying to drown his pain with alcohol and memories. His youth was filled with missed opportunities, unfulfilled feelings, and shattered hopes. But everything changes when a mysterious woman in a sexy circus costume sits down next to him. She calls herself "Harlequin" — a charismatic and enigmatic figure who offers the hero a chance to set things right.

With the help of Harlequin’s magical cards, he can travel back in time and meet six women whose hearts he once failed to win. Each of them is unique: from a passionate teacher to a cold-hearted rocker. However, this journey won’t be easy. To change his fate, he will have to engage in thrilling card games, decipher their personalities, and defeat them in intellectual battles. Victory will bring not only steamy moments but also new perspectives for his future.

In this game, you will experience 10 captivating stories, each tied to one of the six women. Each woman has her own unique mechanics! To win a girl's heart, you must play an exciting card game with her and emerge victorious to unlock hot scenes and more!

  • 6 beautiful women

  • 10 unique stories

  • 12 sex scenes

  • 12 CG artworks

  • 6 unique mini-games

  • A strip card game

  • 4 endings

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains sexual scenes and nudity. There is no violence or coercion to sexual acts. All scenes are subjected to plot and occur in the plot with the consent of the characters
